headlines.title: MOFCOM: China does not deliberately pursue a trade surplus; current account surplus ~3.7% of GDP
headlines.summary: MOFCOM said on July 28 China does not deliberately pursue a trade surplus. Export growth reflects scale economies and rising innovation plus external demand from global green transition and industrialization. Exports to the EU are concentrated in photovoltaics, new-energy vehicle
headlines.title_zh: 商务部：中国不刻意追求贸易顺差；经常账户顺差占GDP比重约3.7%
headlines.summary_zh: 商务部7月28日表示，中国并不刻意追求贸易顺差。出口增长反映了规模经济、创新提升，以及全球绿色转型和工业化带来的外部需求。对欧盟的出口主要集中在光伏、新能源汽车领域。

headlines.title: 商务部：中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差 总体上经常账户顺差占GDP比重处于国际公认合理区间
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月28日讯，商务部7月28日发布《关于所谓“产能过剩”问题的中方立场》，文件指出，中国从不刻意追求贸易顺差。中国出口增长既源于规模经济与创新能力提升，也来自各国绿色转型和工业化发展的需求。比如，中国对欧出口增长主要集中于光伏、新能源汽车、锂电池和化工产品等，更多反映了绿色转型带动对能源产品的需求，以及能源危机抬升了欧洲化工等行业的生产成本。中国也从不刻意追求劳动密集型产品出口份额，相关产品出口比重由2012年的20.7%下降为2025年的15.1%。从贸易利益分配看，“顺差在中国，利益在各方”，2025年外资企业占中国出口的27%、顺差的16%

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: China never deliberately pursues a trade surplus; the current account surplus as a share of GDP is generally within the internationally recognized reasonable range.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce released the 'China Position on the So-Called 'Overcapacity' Issue' on July 28. The document states that China never deliberately pursues a trade surplus. China's export growth stems from both economies of scale and innovation capabilities, as well as demand from global green transformation and industrial development. For example, China's export growth to Europe is mainly concentrated in photovoltaics, new energy vehicles, lithium batteries, and chemical products, reflecting demand for energy products driven by green transformation and the energy crisis raising production costs for European industries like chemicals. China also never deliberately pursues export shares of labor-intensive products, whose share fell from 20.7% in 2012 to 15.1% in 2025. Regarding trade benefit distribution, 'surplus in China, benefits to all parties.' In 2025, foreign-funded enterprises accounted for 27% of China's exports and 16% of the trade surplus.

headlines.title: 国家税务总局：上半年全国税收收入超过10万亿元，同比增长4.9%
headlines.summary: 国家税务总局局长胡静林7月28日在国新办新闻发布会上介绍，今年上半年，税务部门累计征收税费收入16.7万亿元。其中，税收收入超过10万亿元（不含海关代征进口增值税、消费税和关税、船舶吨税，未扣除出口退税），同比增长4.9%。

headlines.title_en: State Administration of Taxation: National tax revenue in the first half of the year exceeded 10 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: Hu Jinglin, Director of the State Taxation Administration, said at a press conference on July 28 that in the first half of the year, tax authorities collected a total of 16.7 trillion yuan in tax revenue. Among this, tax revenue exceeded 10 trillion yuan (excluding customs-collected import VAT, consumption tax, tariffs, and ship tonnage tax, and not deducting export tax rebates), up 4.9% year-on-year.

headlines.title: 香港特区政府与国家工信部签署《关于推进部港共建制造业创新中心的合作协议》
headlines.summary: 香港特区政府与国家工业和信息化部（国家工信部）今日（28日）在特区政府总部签署《关于推进部港共建制造业创新中心的合作协议》。创新科技及工业局局长孙东表示，今年的财政预算案已建议预留资金，在港建设首个境外的国家制造业创新中心，目标是促进关键技术突破、推动成果产业化，以及汇聚国际人才。就此，香港特区政府支持由香港微电子研发院基于现有基础，承担牵头营运创新中心的重任。此举将配合国家的技术与产业规划重点，并在香港现有的半导体生态系统基础上发挥独特优势。（大湾区之声）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SAR Government and MIIT sign cooperation agreement on advancing ministry-Hong Kong joint manufacturing innovation center.
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong SAR government and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology signed a cooperation agreement at the government headquarters today (July 28) on advancing the co-building of a manufacturing innovation center in Hong Kong. Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong said this year's budget proposed reserving funds for Hong Kong's first overseas national manufacturing innovation center, aiming to promote key technological breakthroughs, drive industrialization of outcomes, and gather international talent. The Hong Kong government supports the Hong Kong Microelectronics Research Institute to take the lead in operating the innovation center based on existing foundations. This move will align with national technology and industrial planning priorities and leverage Hong Kong's unique advantages within its existing semiconductor ecosystem (Greater Bay Area Voice).

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际表示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产非本地买家中最大的群体，因香港写字楼板块低迷导致不良资产价格大幅回调，吸引了这些投资者。鉴于写字楼资产价格的走势，未来几个月新加坡的需求有望保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: As of end-June, Shenzhen's outstanding loans reached 10.30 trillion yuan, up 4.6% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: As of end-June, Shenzhen's total loan balance reached 10.30 trillion yuan, up 4.6% year-on-year. The PBOC Shenzhen Branch and SAFE Shenzhen Branch held a press conference for the first half of 2026. Caixin reporters learned that as of end-June 2026, Shenzhen's total RMB and foreign currency deposit and loan scale ranked third among major cities nationwide. Total deposit balance was 15.53 trillion yuan, up 9.7% year-on-year. Total loan balance was 10.30 trillion yuan, up 4.6% year-on-year. In the first half, Shenzhen's aggregate financing to the real economy increased by over 550 billion yuan, significantly more than the same period last year. Direct financing contribution continued to rise, accounting for nearly 30% of total financing, at a high level in the past five years.

headlines.title_en: Morning news summary
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext Index fell over 5% in the morning session, while major consumer stocks bucked the trend with gains. The Hang Seng Index fell 0.11% in the morning session, while the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.16%. Zhipu slumped over 16%, and MINIMAX dropped over 11%. AI 'cash burn' concerns resurfaced, with the South Korean stock market plunging over 10% in intraday trading, and the Nikkei 225 dropping over 4%. SK Hynix fell 30% at one point, a record single-day decline; Kioxia fell 18% at one point. The State Taxation Administration reported that national tax revenue in the first half exceeded 10 trillion yuan, up 4.9% year-on-year. The PBOC conducted 305.5 billion yuan in open market reverse repo operations, with a net daily injection of 52.5 billion yuan. China launched a special action to enhance IPv6 capabilities for AI large models. South Korea vowed to take more measures to curb demand for leveraged ETFs.

headlines.title_en: In H1, overseas individuals in Shenzhen made 106 million non-cash payment transactions, up 20.62% year-on-year.
headlines.summary_en: First half of 2026: Non-cash payments by overseas individuals in Shenzhen reached 106 million transactions, up 20.62% year-on-year. At the first half of 2026 press conference by the PBOC Shenzhen Branch and SAFE Shenzhen Branch, Caixin reporters learned that Shenzhen conducted 44.36 billion yuan in multilateral central bank digital currency bridge transactions in the first half, organized 58 digital yuan red envelope consumption promotion events, and added over 2.05 billion yuan in digital yuan managed funds for prepaid consumption. Additionally, in the first half of 2026, non-cash payment transactions by overseas individuals in Shenzhen totaled 106 million transactions worth 15.616 billion yuan, up 20.62% and 29.42% year-on-year respectively.

headlines.title_en: State Administration of Taxation: China's market entities saw further improvement in activity in H1.
headlines.summary_en: Hu Jinglin, Director of the State Taxation Administration, stated that based on tax data, business entity activity in China further improved in the first half. The number of active business entities handling tax matters and operating normally increased by 20.2% year-on-year, and the number of tax-paying registrations rose by 10% year-on-year. The industrial structure's high-end orientation further improved, with sales revenue from high-tech industries and core digital economy industries up 15% and 8.7% year-on-year respectively, accounting for 1.7 and 1.1 percentage points more of total enterprise sales revenue compared to last year. Meanwhile, profits of high-tech manufacturing and digital product service enterprises grew by 29.2% and 64.4% year-on-year respectively. The robustness of opening up further improved, with the number of foreign-related taxpaying business entities up 10.9% year-on-year, total declared profits of foreign-funded enterprises up 4.5% year-on-year, and export tax rebates processed by tax departments up 7.7% year-on-year, incomplete.

headlines.title_en: Multiple broad-based ETFs see early volume surge as capital continues to flow in.
headlines.summary_en: During the market turbulence on July 28, funds continued to flow in. On the morning of July 28, several broad-based ETFs saw significantly increased trading volume. As of the midday close, the ChiNext ETF (E Fund) traded 7.667 billion yuan, exceeding its full-day volume of 6.741 billion yuan on July 27. The CSI 500 ETF (Southern) also saw a notable volume increase, trading 4.96 billion yuan, surpassing its full-day volume of 4.52 billion yuan the previous day. Recently, funds have been continuously flowing into ETFs. Data shows that on July 27, equity ETFs saw net inflows of over 14 billion yuan; since July, equity ETFs have seen net inflows of nearly 390 billion yuan. With sustained fund inflows, the CSI 300 ETF (Huatai-PineBridge) returned to a scale of over 100 billion yuan, leading the second-ranked fund by over 20 billion yuan. As of July 27, the CSI 300 ETF (Huatai-PineBridge) scale was 117, incomplete.

headlines.title: 分析师：澳洲联储鹰派表态并不意外
headlines.summary: 澳洲联储主席布洛克在讲话中表示，未来进一步加息的可能性仍然存在。她指出，当前通胀水平仍然过高，同时强调央行希望避免市场形成对物价持续上涨的固化预期。分析师JamesGlynn指出，鉴于中东紧张局势再次升级，澳洲联储释放鹰派信号并不令人意外。再次出现燃料价格冲击的风险较高，而从当前情况来看，代价最小的政策路径可能是进一步提高利率。

headlines.title_en: Analyst: RBA's hawkish stance not surprising.
headlines.summary_en: Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Bullock stated in a speech that the possibility of further rate hikes remains. He noted that current inflation is still too high and emphasized that the central bank wants to avoid the market forming entrenched expectations of sustained price increases. Analyst James Glynn noted that given the renewed escalation of Middle East tensions, the RBA's hawkish signal is not surprising. The risk of another fuel price shock is high, and under current conditions, the least costly policy path may be to raise rates further.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Claim that 'China's insufficient domestic demand leads to overcapacity' is inconsistent with facts.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce released the 'China Position on the So-Called 'Overcapacity' Issue' on July 28, stating that the claim 'insufficient domestic demand leads to overcapacity' is inconsistent with facts. China is not only a manufacturing powerhouse but also a major consumer nation. Domestic demand has always been the main engine of China's economy, contributing an average of 93% to economic growth from 2013 to 2024. Converted at World Bank purchasing power parity, China's total retail sales in 2025 are 1.7 times that of the US, making it the world's largest commodity consumption market. Currently, China ranks first globally in physical consumption volume, with per capita annual consumption of some industrial products nearing developed country levels. In recent years, the slower growth of total retail sales aligns with China's shift from high-speed growth to high-quality development and reflects a trend of consumption structure upgrading. Treating China's slower retail sales growth as insufficient domestic demand, incomplete.

headlines.title_en: July 28 midday market close: ChiNext drops over 5% in half-day trading, consumer stocks buck trend to rise.
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market fluctuated and adjusted in the morning session, with the three major indices falling significantly. Consumer stocks like liquor and dairy bucked the trend with gains, with JINZIZUIJIU, YIMING FOOD, DONBAI GROUP hitting their daily limits. Brain-computer interface concepts continued their uptrend, with INNOVATION MEDICAL, HAINAN HAIYAO, NANJING PANDA all rising for two consecutive sessions. Lithography machine concepts surged then retreated, with WAVE OPTICS, ZHANGJIANG HI-TECH, HAILI STOCKS hitting their daily limits. On the downside, computing hardware stocks fell, with CIG SHANGHAI hitting its limit down, and EOPTOLINK, ZHONGJI INNOLIGHT dropping over 10%; semiconductor chip stocks declined, with GIGADEVICE hitting its limit down, and PRAMER, BEIJING INGENIC dropping over 10%. Stocks were mixed, with morning session turnover at 1.34 trillion yuan. At the midday close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.98%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 3.42%, and the ChiNext Index fell 5.37%. 2. Leading sectors included liquor, dairy, education, and software development; lagging sectors included computing hardware, semiconductor chips, coal, and precious metals.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce releases 'China's Position on the So-Called 'Overcapacity' Issue'
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the Ministry of Commerce released 'China's Position on the So-Called Overcapacity Issue,' clarifying relevant facts and elaborating China's policy stance on the matter. The document, aside from the preface and conclusion, consists of four chapters: comprehensively and objectively viewing global capacity and the so-called 'overcapacity,' perspectives on four pairs of relations related to 'overcapacity,' China's commitment to building a modern industrial system through openness and cooperation, and jointly promoting an open and inclusive global production and supply chain cooperation framework.

headlines.title_en: ChiNext Index drops over 6%, Shanghai Composite down 1.44%, Shenzhen Component down 3.93%; computing hardware, semiconductor chips, coal, precious metals lead declines; over 2,900 stocks fall across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext index fell over 6%, the Shanghai Composite Index dropped 1.44%, and the Shenzhen Component Index declined 3.93%, with sectors such as computing hardware, semiconductor chips, coal, and precious metals leading the losses; over 2,900 stocks fell across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
